title: 第021章 神级兵营 始源龙巢第022章 终焉极龙潘吉利娅
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: “没有金币和本源结晶吗？”苏业看着青铜级.深渊宝箱开出来的东西。
四种资源，好不好？肯定是好的，但是对于苏业来说，远远不如金币和本源结晶来的实在。
高级肉类资源卡就不说了，每张一千吨，加上之前的十张，现在苏业就有1010张了。
高级木材资源卡，一张之中封存着一万单位的木材，也是一千张。
高级石材资源卡，一张里面也封存着一万单位的石材，同样也开出来了一千张。
高级铁矿资源卡，一张里面也有一万单位的铁矿，也是开出来最多的有三千张。
高级资源卡一张的话基本上都是100本源结晶一张。
可惜现在还没人能买得起，有这个本源结晶，普通领主基本上都是先提升领主之心去了，谁会花钱买这种高级资源卡。
不是说不重要，而是现阶段对于新手领主来说，本源结晶更加的珍惜一些。
“亏了啊。”苏业有些蛋疼的看着青铜级.深渊宝箱开出来的东西，从总价值上来说，比之前开的宝箱都要高。
但是从实用的角度来说，普通领主根本就用不起这东西，初级的或者中级的都要好一些，偏偏是高级的。
苏业还不能说什么，毕竟开出来的资源总价值是真的不低，只不过现在不适合罢了。
“这算是幸福的烦恼吧，其他人想开还开不到，自己还在这里嫌弃。”苏业不由的摇了摇头，将资源卡都收了起来。
这些东西苏业也没打算出售，毕竟他也需要，建设领地这些基础资源是不可或缺的存在。
“希望评分宝箱能开出一些，自己目前能用的东西吧。”苏业看向sss深渊难度评分宝箱。
【叮：是否打开sss深渊难度宝箱？】
“开。”苏业带着期待的看着sss深渊难度宝箱。
【叮：你获得紫色图纸：闪电塔！】
【叮：你获得紫色图纸：逐风弓！】
【叮：你获得一阶兵营：绿蜥之巢！】
【叮：你获得唯一奇观：永恒之塔！】
苏业看着sss深渊难度宝箱开出来的东西，两张图纸，一座兵营，一件奇观。
还是紫色的图纸，图纸的等级分为：白绿青蓝紫金红七个等级的图纸，紫色图纸就意味着源源不断的资源。
苏业开始一一查看了起来。
姓名：闪电塔
等级：紫色
类型：防御塔
学习需求：无
ps：领地防御建筑，任何兵种，领主都可学习，学习之后可重复建造。
“防御塔啊。”苏业看着手中的紫色图纸带着一丝犹豫，要不要学习？紫色领地防御建筑，从某种程度上来说，意义非凡。
理论上来说，只要资源足够，那就能够无限建造这样的防御塔，不过对于苏业来说，好像没有那个必要。
有点浪费资源了，如果说自己的兵种都无法抵挡的入侵，这些防御塔建造的再多也没什么用。
最主要的是这类建筑通常造出来都是1级，后续还需要海量的资源升级，这对于苏业来说弊大于利。
“算了，先收着后面在看。”苏业想了想还是收起来，现在卖的话也只能贱卖，苏业不是其他领主，缺资源需要贱卖手里的东西。
苏业看向了下一张图纸。
姓名：逐风弓
等级：紫色
类型：武器
需求：工匠类兵种可学习！
ps:紫色级别的兵种武器，需要工匠类特殊兵种才能学习。
content_en:
"Aren't there any gold coins and origin crystals?" Su Ye looked at what came out of the bronze-level abyss treasure chest.
Four resources, okay? It is definitely good, but for Su ye, it is far less practical than gold coins and origin crystals.
Not to mention the high-end meat resource cards, each one has a thousand tons. Adding the previous ten cards, Su ye now has 1,010.
There are 1,000 advanced wood resource cards that contain 10,000 units of wood.
A high-grade stone resource card also contains 10,000 units of stone, and a thousand units were also opened.
A high-end iron ore resource card contains 10,000 units of iron ore, and the most issued one is 3,000.
A high-level resource card basically costs 100 source crystals.
It's a pity that no one can afford it now. With this source crystal, ordinary lords basically upgrade their lord's heart first. Who would spend money to buy such a high-level resource card.
It’s not that it’s not important, but at this stage, for novice lords, source crystals are more cherished.
"What a loss." Su Ye looked at the bronze-level abyss treasure chest with some pain. In terms of total value, it was higher than the treasure chests he had opened before.
But from a practical point of view, ordinary lords can't afford this thing at all. The junior or intermediate ones are better, but the advanced ones are better.
Su ye can't say anything yet. After all, the total value of the resources released is really not low, but it's just not suitable now.
"This can be considered a happy trouble. Others can't open it even if they want to, and I feel disgusted that I'm still here." Su ye couldn't help but shook his head and put away all the resource cards.
Su ye didn't plan to sell these things. After all, he also needed them. Basic resources such as territory construction were indispensable.
"I hope the rating treasure chest can open some things that I can use now." Su Ye looked at the SSS Abyss Difficulty Rating Treasure Box.
[Ding: Do you want to open the SSS Abyss difficulty treasure chest? 】
"Open." Su ye looked at the SSS Abyss Difficulty Treasure Box with anticipation.
[Ding: You get the purple blueprint: Lightning Tower! 】
[Ding: You get the purple blueprint: Wind Chasing Bow! 】
[Ding: You have obtained the first-level barracks: Green Lizard’s Nest! 】
[Ding: You get the only wonder: the Tower of Eternity! 】
.............
Su Ye looked at what came out of the SSS Abyss Difficulty Treasure Box, two drawings, a barracks, and a wonder.
It's still a purple blueprint. The blueprints are divided into seven levels: white, green, blue, purple, gold, and red. Purple blueprints mean a steady stream of resources.
Su ye began to check them one by one.
Name: Lightning Tower
Level: Purple
Type: defense tower
Learning requirements: none
ps: Territory defense buildings can be learned by lords of any military type and can be built repeatedly after learning.
"Defense tower." Su Ye looked at the purple blueprint in his hand with a hint of hesitation. Do you want to learn? The purple territorial defense building is, to some extent, of great significance.
Theoretically, as long as the resources are sufficient, such defense towers can be built indefinitely, but for Su ye, it seems that there is no need.
It's a bit of a waste of resources. If your own troops can't resist the invasion, it's useless no matter how many defense towers you build.
The most important thing is that these types of buildings are usually built at level 1, and require massive resource upgrades in the future, which does more harm than good to Su ye.
"Forget it, let's keep it for now and see later." Su ye thought about it and kept it. If he sells it now, he can only sell it at a low price. Su ye is not like other lords. He lacks resources and needs to sell his things at a low price.
Su ye looked at the next drawing.
Name: Zhufeng Bow
Level: Purple
Type: Weapon
Requirements: Craftsman-type arms can be learned!
ps: Purple-level military weapons require special craftsman-type weapons to learn.
